content_sections.heading: IPGME&R Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 6651 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IPGME&R notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: First Class MSc/integrated PG degrees in a relevant subject (such as Life Sciences, Microbiology, Physiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry etc.) with at least 5 years experience, post MSc; OR PhD in a relevant subject (such as Life Sciences, Microbiology, Physiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry etc.) with at least 2 years experience post PhD Experience: At least 5 years post MSc, or at least 2 years post PhD Other conditions: Preference to candidates with command of Bengali, Hindi and English language Desirable: NET-/NET-LS/Inspire Fellowship/equivalent qualification Hands on experience in modern immunological and molecular biology techniques Experience of undertaking field visits and management of lab data At least two publications as first author in an indexed Journal

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post is temporary and contractual, for a period till the end of the project; may be extended as per the need for the project Engagement for 3 years, renewable every 6 months, subject to satisfactory performance Candidates not suitably performing may be terminated with one month prior notice

content_sections.heading: How Will IPGME&R Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Personal appearance before the Selection Committee (walk-in interview) Eligible candidates appear personally before the Selection Committee

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled in application form (given with the notice) Recent CV Set of self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents Original copies of all relevant documents and testimonials

content_sections.text: Fill in the application form given below the notice (page 2). Tag a recent CV and a set of self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents to the filled application form. Appear personally before the Selection Committee on 19.11.2026 from 11 am at the Museum, Dept. of Pharmacology, 5th floor, IPGME&R, Kolkata-20. Bring original copies of all relevant documents and testimonials on the day of the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IPGME&R Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 19 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IPGME&R Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Associate.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IPGME&R Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 19 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Museum, Dept. of Pharmacology, 5th floor, IPGME&R, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 70,000 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: First Class MSc/integrated PG degree in a relevant subject (such as Life Sciences, Microbiology, Physiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry etc.) with at least 5 years experience post MSc, OR PhD in a relevant subject with at least 2 years experience post PhD.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Preference to candidates with command of Bengali, Hindi and English language.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Personal appearance before the Selection Committee (walk-in interview). Eligible candidates appear personally before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post is temporary and contractual, for a period till the end of the project; may be extended as per the need for the project. Engagement for 3 years, renewable every 6 months, subject to satisfactory performance. Candidates not suitably performing may be terminated with one month prior notice.
